summary: The project aims to design a new remote control that is original, trendy, and user-friendly. The remote should be sold for 25 euros with a production cost not exceeding 12.50 euros. It should control TV, satellite, and VCR, and have a unique selling point. The team will work on design, user interface, technical functions, and marketing requirements.
